overview.brief: Northern Desert of Ro south of Freeport (tools page: North Ro). Dervish camps, tarantulas, mummies, orcs, madmen; sand giants on travel routes. Connects to East Freeport, East Commonlands, Oasis of Marr, New Sebilis Expedition. EQ Legends Tools recommends 1–11.
